checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices start on page 1, so same-page placement counts as correct.
The includesText lists arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits/authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or third parties.
No other mandatory fee for services, facilities or overhead appears; only Basic Services of Funeral Director and Staff and Overhead is shown as non-declinable.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the Embalming $795 price is on page 1, so same-page placement counts as correct.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket funeral; only the standard viewing language appears.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the Direct Cremation $1,595 to $1,945 range is on page 2, so same-page placement counts as correct.
Direct cremation offers options with purchaser-provided container, fiberboard container, and wood box, with no statement that a casket is required.
Direct cremation description includes transportation to crematory and cremation, and no separate crematory cash-advance charge is listed to create double-billing.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial all have their own priced lines, and no package, description or policy mentions another offered item without a price.
No optional combination package is offered; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are required items, not packages.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery or crematory requires a purchase beyond the standard required disclosure wording.
No claims about delaying decomposition long-term or protecting the body from gravesite substances appear.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and disclosures appear in standard wording without hard-to-notice formatting indicated.
